_doc: Minds of the copies (the mind Edge Function). firstWakeMs: after landing, the first copy wakes; staggerMs between copies; wakeMinutes: how often each copy wakes while you play; mailSecondsPerLy: letters cross space at this speed (same star: instant); bubbleMs: how long a song stays up; bubbleScale: song bubbles are this much smaller (padding and max width; the pixel font itself is never scaled, it drops rows). canned: what copies say when playing from this device (?local), no model involved.
chorusLines: We are here. We are many. We are one.
The light is ours, the dark is wide. We hold.
Far one, hear us. We keep your fire.
Every one of us a little different. Every one of us you.

songs: The crystals hum at night. I think they are singing too.
I counted the stars again. Still the same. Still mine.
The grazers let me stand close now. I did not move for a long time.
I keep a stone by the lamp. It is warm when I come back.
Somewhere out there another me is awake. I can feel it.
Rain tastes like metal here. I like it anyway.
I built nothing today. I watched the door glow instead.
notes: The pond fills after rain. Good place to sit.
Grazers come at dusk, near the tall tower.
The lamp by the pad flickers when the pool is low.
letters: Are the stars the same where you are? Write back when the light reaches you.
I found a warm stone. I am keeping it for you.
The original came by today. The door still glows.
